meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抛出研究问题，得到带引用、经质检的调研报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对某个问题做系统调研并要可核实的引用来源。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, QA-checked report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic investigation with verifiable citations.

howto.what: 你要求研究时,它会组建协作研究团队:把主题拆成多个研究轴分派成员,追查每条线索,用辩论互相质疑发现,对存疑结论跑代码验证,最终产出每条论断都带引用或证明的综述,并把过程写入会话日志。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求研究、深度调查或超精确调查时才接管,包括提到 “ulw-research”、“ultradebate” 等措辞;普通提问或调试不会触发,它只会提示该技能可用。

say.text: ulw-research,帮我彻底研究一下这个主题
用 ulw-research 深挖这个话题,每条结论都要给引用
say.note: 产出每条论断都有引用或证明的综述

say.text: 对这个说法做一次 ultradebate 研究,有争议的地方跑代码验证
say.note: 会发起辩论回合并执行验证脚本

howto.what_en: When you ask for research, it builds a cooperating team, splits the topic into axes, cross-critiques findings in debate, proves contested claims by running code, and delivers a synthesis where every claim has a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for research, deep research or an ultra-precise investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording or 'ultradebate' requests; ordinary questions don't trigger it.

say_en.text: ulw-research — do a deep investigation of X
say_en.note: Opens with ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED! and stands up a team.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic, cite every claim
Do an ultradebate research pass and verify contested claims in code
say_en.note: Runs debate rounds plus verification scripts.
